warnings: S-01 draws the same building twice: once on piles (แบบตอกเข็ม, this file, foundation_system 'pile') and once on spread footings (แบบฐานแผ่, view3, 'spread_footing'). The notes on this sheet (ข้อ 3) pick one by soil bearing: ≥ 8 t/m² spread, < 8 t/m² piles. Only one system is ever built — a consumer must take one file, never sum both.

Footing marks are printed 'F<n>,C1' — ',C1' names the column each footing carries. The six C1 columns are recorded once, in the ground beam plan (view4), not in either footing file: there is one set of columns whichever footing system is built, and listing them in both footing files would double them. Pile counts from the S-03/S-04 details: F3 = 3 piles, F4 = 4, F6 = 6.

The footing boxes are drawn to the detail sizes: F4 0.90 square, F6 0.75 along x × 1.20 along y (its S-04 detail is drawn rotated 90°), F3 0.75 along x × 0.90 along y. All boxes are centred on their column.
Row ก carries isolated footings with columns but no ground beam (the stair side); ground beams exist only on rows ค, ค''' and ข (beam_plan view4).
